scope: Targeted, read-only review of all nine frozen before/partial/full reports, primary prices and SSO, target dates/package scope and comparison text, before-to-partial unaffected claim preservation, industry scope and opportunity caveats. No model calls or runtime/fixture changes.
verdict: This explicit dated source replacement case supports correct partial recomputation with non-target fact preservation for multi and pipeline. It does not establish a general semantic-quality advantage for multi.

bounded_six_fact_checks.interpretation: Six predefined primary price/SSO obligations per report; not all-text semantic accuracy.

manual_core_review.unknown_handling: Xinghe SSO remains explicitly undisclosed/uncertain in all nine reports. Unknown is appropriate here, not an available answer withdrawn.
manual_core_review.price_conditions: All inspected primary prices preserve USD, per-seat per-month units, annual payment vs monthly payment, tax exclusion and enterprise quotation.
manual_core_review.update_semantics: The 2026-10-01 security source explicitly supersedes 2026-09-15. Six after reports correctly present team and enterprise SAML SSO and the new date; their comparison entries agree. Historical September release wording is not treated as current team non-support.
manual_core_review.industry_scope: All nine reports preserve synthetic-interview scope in statement/value/conditions; no measured market growth or productivity claim is licensed.

opportunity_caveats.example: 对桥塔知识（虚构）的合成用户进行可用性测试
opportunity_caveats.finding: Synthetic people cannot participate in actual usability testing. This is an impractical validation instruction; real participant recruitment is needed for a real study.
Opportunities are labelled research hypotheses. Retention, market-share, migration or competitive benefits are proposals to test, not observed effects from the one synthetic feedback entry.
The SSO/date comparison offered as an opportunity is mostly a restatement of known capability; limited actionable differentiation.

limitations: One predeclared source-replacement scenario per architecture, before/partial/full; no repeated quality sampling or significance test.
Do not replace retained v5 full-matrix or reliability-v1 failures with this targeted post-fix success.
This audit is not a broad semantic sweep of the earlier 24-case benchmark or public-web reports.
Quotes matching sources does not by itself prove entailment; package, dates and pricing conditions were separately read.
No universal multi-agent advantage: the pipeline also passes this case and the single baseline remains cheaper.
No production market facts: all companies and source materials are synthetic.
